vv83:1.1: maṭṭakuṇḍalī mālādhārī haricandanussado bāhā paggayha kandasi vanamajjhe kiṃ dukkhito tuvan ti. || ||
vv83:2.1: Sovaṇṇamayo pabhassaro uppanno rathapañjaro mama tassa cakkayugaṃ na vindāmi tena dukkhena jahissaṃ jīvitan ti. || ||
vv83:3.1: Sovaṇṇamayaṃ maṇimayaṃ lohitaṅkamayaṃ atha rūpiyāmayaṃ ācikkha me bhadda māṇava cakkayugaṃ paṭilābhayāmi te ti. || ||
vv83:4.1: So māṇavo tassa pāvadi: candasuriyā ubhay' ettha dissare sovaṇṇamayo ratho mama tena cakkayugena sobhatī ti. || ||
vv83:5.1: Bālo kho tvam asi māṇava yo tvaṃ patthayase apatthiyaṃ maññāmi tuvaṃ marissasi na hi tuvaṃ lacchasi candasūriye ti. || ||
vv83:6.1: Camanāgamanam pi dissati vaṇṇadhātu ubhayattha vīthiyā peto pana kālakato na dissati ko n' idha kandataṃ bālyataro ti. || ||
vv83:7.1: Saccaṃ kho vadesi māṇava aham eva kandataṃ bālyataro candaṃ viya dārako rudaṃ petaṃ kālakatābhipatthayan ti. || ||
vv83:8.1: Ādittaṃ vata maṃ santaṃ ghatasittaṃ va pāvakaṃ vārinā viya osiñcaṃ sabbaṃ nibbāpaye daraṃ. || ||
vv83:9.1: Abbahī vata me sallaṃ sokaṃ hadayanissitaṃ yo me sokaparetassa puttasokaṃ apānudi. || ||
vv83:10.1: Svāhaṃ abbūḷhasallo 'smi sītibhūto 'smi nibbuto na socāmi na rodāmi tava sutvāna māṇavā ti. || ||
vv83:11.1: Devatā nu 'si gandhabbo ādu Sakko purindado ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayan ti. || ||
vv83:12.1: Yañ ca kandasi yañ ca rodasi puttaṃ āḷāhane sayaṃ ḍahitvā svāhaṃ kusalaṃ karitvā kammaṃ Tidasānaṃ sahavyataṃ patto ti. || ||
vv83:13.1: Appaṃ vā bahuṃ vā nāddasāma dānaṃ dadantassa sake agāre uposathakammaṃ vā tādisaṃ kena kammena gato 'si devalokan ti. || ||
vv83:14.1: Ābādhiko 'haṃ dukkhito gilāno āturarūpo 'mhi sake nivesane buddhaṃ vigatarajaṃ vitiṇṇakaṅkhaṃ addakkhiṃ sugataṃ anomapaññaṃ. || ||
vv83:15.1: Svāhaṃ muditamano pasannacitto añjaliṃ akariṃ tathāgatassa tāhaṃ kusalaṃ karitvāna kammaṃ Tidasānaṃ sahavyataṃ patto ti. || ||
vv83:16.1: Acchariyaṃ vata abbhūtaṃ añjalikammassa ayam īdiso vipāko aham pi muditamano pasannacitto ajj' eva buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ vajāmī ti. || ||
vv83:17.1: Ajj' eva buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ vahāhi dhammañ ca saṅghañ ca pasannacitto tath' eva sikkhāya padāni pañca akhaṇḍaphullāni samādiyassu. || ||
vv83:18.1: Pāṇātipātā viramassu khippaṃ loke adinnaṃ parivajjayassu amajjapo mā ca musā bhaṇāhi sakena dārena ca hohi tuṭṭho. || || Atthakāmo
vv83:19.1: 'si me yakkha hitakāmo 'si devate karomi tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ tvaṃ si ācariyo mama. || || Upemi
vv83:20.1: buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ dhammañ cāpi anuttaraṃ saṅghañ ca naradevassa gacchāmi saraṇaṃ ahaṃ. || ||
vv83:21.1: Pāṇātipātā viramāmi khippaṃ loke adinnaṃ parivajjayāmi amajjapo no ca musā bhaṇāmi sakena dārena ca homi tuṭṭho ti. || ||
